title: Unit – 1 : Session – 6 : SLO – 2  |  Storage Management — Unscramble and Concepts
sections: SECONDARY STORAGE — non-volatile storage (HDD, SSD) managed by the OS.
FILE SYSTEM — OS component that organizes files and directories on storage.
FREE-SPACE MANAGEMENT — tracking which disk blocks are free (bitmap, linked list).
ALLOCATION — assigning disk blocks to files: contiguous, linked, or indexed allocation.
DISK SCHEDULING — ordering pending disk I/O requests (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN).
CACHING and BUFFERING — keeping frequently used data in memory to reduce disk access.
II. Role of the OS in Secondary Storage Management
The OS manages free space, allocates storage to files, schedules disk requests to minimize
seek time, and uses caching/buffering to improve I/O performance.
